rooms.name: Entry Hall
rooms.description: A narrow stone vestibule where wet coats steam beside a brass weather station. Beyond its arched doors, the dome glows with cold starlight.

rooms.name: Telescope Dome
rooms.description: A copper-ribbed glass dome above the cloud line. The telescope is still aimed at the turquoise tail of Starfall.

rooms.name: Darkroom
rooms.description: Red safelights stain the trays and drying racks. The padded sleeve for the comet negative is empty.

rooms.name: Chart Archive
rooms.description: Star charts, accession ledgers, and a locked cabinet line this quiet room. Ink and cedar mask the smell of damp wool.

rooms.name: Generator Room
rooms.description: A compact dynamo hums beneath the observatory. Its brass gauge is steady, and the belt is warm but intact.
